title: Why AI Leaders Have Changed Their Minds About AI Safety, Elon on UHI, Anthropic’s IPO
description:
The mates sit down with Emad Mostaque to discuss the shifting debate around AI safety, whether we can still “win safely,” the case for AI optimism, Elon Musk’s vision for abundance and universal high income, Anthropic’s reported $2 trillion IPO ambitions, and the White House’s proposed AI accord.
